ui.cannotSave: Saving is not available here (the app has no access to the Supervisor).
ui.cecLocked_ha_integration: Home Assistant's HDMI-CEC integration is active, so the app stays out of CEC. Checked at every app start.
ui.cecLocked_in_use: Another program already uses HDMI-CEC, so the app stays out. Checked at every app start.
ui.cec_ha_integration: Used by Home Assistant's HDMI-CEC integration – the app stays out
ui.cec_in_use: Used by another program – the app leaves it alone
ui.cec_waiting: Waiting for Home Assistant to finish starting
ui.copyBlocked: Copying is blocked here: select the text below and copy it yourself.
ui.hdmiPausedResume: Stopped: no display is connected to HDMI. It starts again when the display is back.
ui.nCecEmpty: No CEC messages yet. Press keys on the remote of the TV or projector (TV7 selected as input).
ui.nerdTip: Show all technical details: codec, bitrate, dropped frames, display output, clock, mpv log.
ui.setIntro: Changes are stored as the app's options, so they also show up in the app configuration. Settings marked "restart" take effect after the app restarts.
ui.stoppedCec: Stopped: the TV is in standby or shows another source.
ui.supportDone: Copied: paste it into a new GitHub issue
ui.supportHint: Markdown text for a GitHub issue: versions, device, playback, display output, environment, options and mpv log. Tokens, passwords, IP and MAC addresses and URL parameters are replaced by ****.
ui.tipCpu: Load of the whole device, all CPU cores together.
ui.tipDecode: Who decodes the video: hardware = the video decoder of the device (almost no CPU load), software = the processor.
ui.tipHdmi: State of the HDMI connection to your TV or receiver.
ui.tipMpv: Load of the mpv player in percent of one CPU core: 100 % is one full core, 400 % all four.
ui.tipOut: Resolution and refresh rate the player sends to your display.
ui.tipRender: Who draws the picture: GPU = the graphics chip (low CPU load), CPU = the processor (higher load).
ui.tipTemp: Temperature of the processor. Above about 80 °C a Raspberry Pi slows itself down.
